meta.subject: fix bug in advance pc in proc for div and rem

en.summary: Fixes issue control for DIVU and REMU so the PC does not advance while the shared divider is still busy and the instruction has not actually issued.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says it fixes a bug in PC advance for divide and remainder instructions.
The only changed file is the main processor RTL file src/proc.sv.
The added assignments are exactly on the divider-busy retry paths, which directly govern whether the next instruction is fetched.
evidence: Both DIVU and REMU busy branches now assign skip_advance_pc = 1.
The same task ends with if(~skip_advance_pc) read_next_instr(pc + 4), so those new assignments directly prevent premature fetch.
When the divider is not busy, the code already set skip_advance_pc = 1 and moved to state C2, showing the intended behavior was to stall until divide completion.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A non-pipelined or shared long-latency functional unit must stall front-end progress until a new request is accepted or the outstanding request completes. If the retry path for a busy divider fails to hold the PC or issue state, the core will fetch the next instruction even though the divide or remainder instruction has not yet issued, causing instruction loss or mis-sequencing.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: busy-stall gating for a shared divide or remainder unit
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A DIV or REM instruction is decoded while the divider reports busy and the core intends to retry later rather than issuing immediately.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: On the unit-busy retry path, allow the PC or fetch pointer to advance instead of stalling.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop a stall assignment in the functional-unit-busy branch
portability_notes: The same idea applies to any shared multi-cycle ALU, multiplier, divider, or transcendental unit.
The exact symptom depends on whether the design retries the instruction in place or replays it from a queue.
If the design uses valid/ready instead of an explicit PC-hold flag, inject the bug by falsely asserting ready or dequeueing the instruction early.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the decode or issue logic for divide and remainder operations and identify the branch taken when the unit is busy.
Remove the control assignment that freezes the PC, fetch pointer, or issue slot on that busy path.
Keep the rest of the retry behavior intact so the operation still waits for the divider eventually, but only after front-end state has already moved on.
Do not change the normal successful issue path; the bug should only appear when the unit is back-pressured.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DIVU and REMU handling inside the proc decode/execute task
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds skip_advance_pc = 1 to the divider-busy else branches for DIVU and REMU so read_next_instr(pc + 4) does not fire while the divider is occupied.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the newly added skip_advance_pc = 1 assignments from the busy branches while leaving the final if(~skip_advance_pc) read_next_instr(pc + 4) logic unchanged.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The PC advances past a divide or remainder instruction that has not actually issued yet, leading to skipped or misordered instructions and eventually wrong architectural state.
evidence_for_injection: The only diff is the addition of skip_advance_pc in the divider-busy paths.
The code already stalled correctly on the successful divide-request path, so the missing stall on the busy retry path was the bug.
PC advance is explicitly controlled by skip_advance_pc at the end of the task.
notes: The bug is easiest to trigger with back-to-back divide or remainder operations or any workload that keeps the divider occupied.
This is a control bug even if the divider datapath itself is correct.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DIVU/REMU 的发射控制：当共享除法器仍然 busy 且该指令尚未真正发射时，PC 不应继续前进。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是除法/取余指令的 PC 前进错误。
唯一修改的文件是主处理器 RTL 文件 src/proc.sv。
新增赋值正好位于“除法器 busy 时的重试路径”上，而这条路径直接决定是否继续取下一条指令。
evidence: DIVU 和 REMU 的 busy 分支现在都会赋值 skip_advance_pc = 1。
同一 task 的末尾有 if(~skip_advance_pc) read_next_instr(pc + 4)，因此这些新赋值会直接阻止过早取指。
当除法器不 busy 时，代码本来就会设置 skip_advance_pc = 1 并进入 C2，说明设计意图一直是等待除法完成期间暂停前端。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 对于非流水化或共享的长延迟功能单元，前端必须在请求真正被接受或旧请求完成前停止推进。如果“功能单元 busy 时的重试路径”没有保持 PC 或 issue 状态，核心就会在除法或取余指令尚未发射时继续抓取下一条指令，从而造成指令丢失或乱序。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 共享除法/取余单元的 busy 停顿门控
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 译码到 DIV 或 REM 指令时，除法器报告 busy，核心原本应当稍后重试而不是立即发射。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在功能单元 busy 的重试路径上，允许 PC 或取指指针继续前进，而不是停顿。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除功能单元 busy 分支中的停顿赋值
portability_notes: 同样适用于任何共享的多周期 ALU、乘法器、除法器或其他长延迟单元。
具体症状取决于设计是在原地重试还是通过队列重放该指令。
如果设计使用 valid/ready 而不是显式的 PC-hold 信号，可通过错误地拉高 ready 或过早出队来注入该缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到除法/取余操作的译码或发射逻辑，并定位“功能单元 busy 时”的分支。
删除该 busy 路径上冻结 PC、取指指针或 issue 槽位的控制赋值。
保留其它重试行为不变，使该操作最终仍会等待除法器，但此时前端状态已经错误地前进。
不要修改正常成功发射路径；该缺陷应只在单元背压时出现。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: proc 中 DIVU 与 REMU 的译码/执行处理
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 DIVU 和 REMU 的 divider-busy else 分支中加入 skip_advance_pc = 1，从而在除法器忙碌时阻止 read_next_instr(pc + 4) 触发。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 busy 分支中新加入的 skip_advance_pc = 1，同时保持末尾 if(~skip_advance_pc) read_next_instr(pc + 4) 逻辑不变。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: PC 会越过一条尚未真正发射的除法或取余指令，导致指令被跳过或乱序，最终出现错误的架构状态。
evidence_for_injection: 整个提交只是在除法器 busy 路径上增加了 skip_advance_pc。
代码在“成功发射到除法器”的路径上本来就会停顿，因此缺陷正是“忙时重试路径漏掉停顿”。
task 末尾明确由 skip_advance_pc 控制 PC 是否前进。
notes: 使用背靠背 DIV/REM 指令或让除法器长期占用的工作负载最容易触发。
即使除法器数据通路本身正确，这仍然是一个控制逻辑缺陷。
